info.title: Cartesi Rollups Node API
info.description: A JSON-RPC API for reading rollups data. It provides information about applications, epochs, inputs, outputs, and reports in a read-only fashion.

methods.name: cartesi_listApplications
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of all applications.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of applications to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point for the list of applications to return.

params.name: descending
params.description: if true, the list will be sorted in descending order by application name.

methods.name: cartesi_getApplication
methods.description: Fetches a single application by its name or address.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

methods.name: cartesi_listEpochs
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of epochs for the specified application. Can filter by epoch status.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter epochs by status.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of epochs to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point for the list of epochs to return.

params.name: descending
params.description: if true, the list will be sorted in descending order by epoch index.

result.name: result
result.description: A paginated list of epochs, with the proofs omitted

methods.name: cartesi_getEpoch
methods.description: Fetches a single epoch by application and index.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: epoch_index
params.description: The index of the epoch to be retrieved (hex encoded).

methods.name: cartesi_getLastAcceptedEpochIndex
methods.summary: Get the last accepted epoch index
methods.description: Fetches the latest accepted epoch index by application.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

methods.name: cartesi_listInputs
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of inputs, with options to filter by epoch index or input sender.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: epoch_index
params.description: Filter inputs by a specific epoch index (hex encoded).

params.name: sender
params.description: Filter inputs by the sender's address (hex encoded), extracted from raw data.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of inputs to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point for the list of inputs to return.

params.name: descending
params.description: if true, the list will be sorted in descending order by input index.

methods.name: cartesi_getInput
methods.description: Retrieves a single input from the application using the specified input_index.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: input_index
params.description: The index of the input to be retrieved (hex encoded).

methods.name: cartesi_getProcessedInputCount
methods.summary: Retrieve the number of inputs processed by the application
methods.description: Return a integer with the amount of inputs already processed by the application.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

methods.name: cartesi_listOutputs
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of outputs, with options to filter by epoch index, input index, output type and voucher address.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: epoch_index
params.description: Filter outputs by a specific epoch index (hex encoded).

params.name: input_index
params.description: Filter outputs by a specific input index (hex encoded).

params.name: output_type
params.description: Filter outputs by output type (first 4 bytes of raw data hex encoded).

params.name: voucher_address
params.description: Filter outputs by the voucher address (hex encoded), extracted from raw data.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of outputs to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point for the list of outputs to return.

params.name: descending
params.description: if true, the list will be sorted in descending order by output index.

methods.name: cartesi_getOutput
methods.description: Retrieves a single output from the application using the specified output_index.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: output_index
params.description: The index of the output to be retrieved (hex encoded).

methods.name: cartesi_listReports
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of reports for a given application. Optionally filters by epoch_index and input_index.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: epoch_index
params.description: Optional filter by epoch index (hex encoded).

params.name: input_index
params.description: Optional filter by input index (hex encoded).

params.name: descending
params.description: if true, the list will be sorted in descending order by report index.

methods.name: cartesi_getReport
methods.description: Fetches a single report by application and report_index.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: report_index
params.description: The index of the report to be retrieved (hex encoded).

methods.name: cartesi_listWithdrawals
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of Withdrawal events observed for a foreclosed application. Each row corresponds to one (account_index, account, output) tuple emitted on-chain by IApplication after the accounts drive has been proved. The event fires at most once per accountIndex, so listing all rows for an application enumerates every successful withdrawal.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: account_index
params.description: Optional filter by accountIndex (hex encoded). When omitted, returns all withdrawals for the application.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of withdrawals to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting point for the list of withdrawals to return.

params.name: descending
params.description: if true, the list will be sorted in descending order by account_index.

methods.name: cartesi_getWithdrawal
methods.description: Fetches a single Withdrawal event by application and accountIndex.

params.name: application
params.description: The application's name or hex encoded address.

params.name: account_index
params.description: The accountIndex of the withdrawal to retrieve (hex encoded).

methods.name: cartesi_getNodeVersion
methods.description: Fetches the semantic version of the Cartesi rollups node.

enabled.description: Operator intent. True means the operator wants the node to keep observing the application and run eligible workflows.

reason.description: Human-readable failure description. Non-null when status is FAILED, DIVERGED, or CORRUPTED; null otherwise. Foreclosure is reported separately via foreclose_block, not via status.

last_accounts_drive_proved_check_block.description: Highest block scanned by the post-foreclosure accounts-drive-proved discovery loop. Strictly monotonic; only populated for foreclosed applications.

last_withdrawal_check_block.description: Highest block scanned by the post-foreclosure Withdrawal-event discovery loop. Strictly monotonic; only populated once the accounts drive has been proved.

foreclose_block.description: Block where the on-chain Foreclosure event was observed. Zero means the node has not yet observed a foreclosure (block 0 is unreachable for the event, so it is an unambiguous sentinel). Non-zero is one-way: once set, normal execution stops and evmreader transitions into post-foreclosure observation (drive-prove discovery, then Withdrawal indexing).

foreclose_transaction.description: Transaction hash of the Foreclosure event. All-zero (0x000...0) when foreclose_block is zero; otherwise the tx that emitted the event.

accounts_drive_proved_block.description: Block where the proveAccountsDriveMerkleRoot transaction landed for this foreclosed application. Zero means the drive has not yet been proved (or this application is not foreclosed). Non-zero gates withdrawal eligibility — the contract rejects withdraw() before the drive is proved.

accounts_drive_proved_transaction.description: Transaction hash of the proveAccountsDriveMerkleRoot call. Best-effort: when the per-block tx hunt cannot identify the producing transaction, this field is the zero hash. The (block, root) tuple is canonical regardless.

accounts_drive_merkle_root.description: On-chain accountsDriveMerkleRoot read at accounts_drive_proved_block. All-zero when the drive has not been proved.

Withdrawal.description: A Withdrawal event observed for a foreclosed IApplication after its accounts drive has been proved. account and output are stored as raw bytes; recipient encoding inside account is defined by the per-app WithdrawalOutputBuilder and is opaque to the node.

WithdrawalConfig.description: On-chain WithdrawalConfig mirroring the five Application contract immutables (guardian, log2_leaves_per_account, log2_max_num_of_accounts, accounts_drive_start_index, withdrawal_output_builder). The all-zero shape encodes 'no withdrawal handling configured' — applications without a guardian cannot be foreclosed.
